open.label: Open board {{name}}

new.name: Name
new.placeNote: Where this board is kept. Save writes there from then on.

new.notStored: The board was made, but not stored: {{reason}}. Save will ask where it belongs.

nothing.title: Stored states
nothing.text: A state is a whole board as it was: its pages, and the connections, sources and variables behind them.
